dct_description_sm:
Includes data required to create York Region Official Plan – 2010 Map 5: Woodlands. Data such on the location of woodlands, conservation areas, regional forest, provincial park/natural reserve and rouge park were used for this map.

The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
